header: The OCR of an upload, Gemini only. A PRIMARY Gemini model (default gemini-3.1-pro-preview) reads each page image and, at the same time, a CHECKER Gemini model (default gemini-3.8-flash) reads it too. The primary reading is the page's text. I compare the two readings number by number (readingCheck.ts); the numbers only the primary has are recorded as UNCONFIRMED (the answer card refuses a number nobody confirmed) and the numbers only the checker has are recorded too. I never decide anything silently. What happens when a reader fails (the upload must never store a page it did not read):
- the primary fails, is cut off, or its daily allowance is used up -> the checker's reading is the text (and no check is recorded: the page was read once);
- the checker fails -> the primary's reading is the text (read once);
- both fail, or both were cut off -> the page is reported in `failedPages`; the caller must refuse the upload (a circular with an unread page is not stored, and nothing is left behind).
At most `concurrency` readings run at a time. This file is pure of any database; the readers are passed in, so I test it with fake readers.

behaviours: agreeing readers: the page is read and checked
the summary says all pages agree
a number only the primary has is recorded unconfirmed
a failed primary falls back to the checker, unchecked
a failed checker leaves the primary's text, unchecked
a page neither reader could read is reported as failed
two cut-off readings leave the page failed
a cut-off primary uses the complete checker reading
after a daily-limit refusal the primary is not asked again
readings of different pages are not compared
textOf of a page never started throws
past the deadline a page is failed, not stored empty
without GEMINI_API_KEY the readers refuse to be created
the default readers are Flash (primary) and another Flash model (checker): no Pro models any more
